text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: service="inference-api" p99 latency alert fired (threshold=2.5s). alert summary: 5% above threshold over 5m. PD-2791

morgan: acked. I'm taking the page — will triage.

derek_oncall: on it, checking recent deploys and autoscaling.

morgan: looks like spike concentrated in eu-west, p95 -> 1.4s, p99 -> 3.1s. Grafana metric: `inference.latency.p99 = 3.1s`

samir: any correlation with kvcache? seeing high evictions: `kvcache.evictions = 1200` in the window

maya: logs show a burst of `LoadModel` calls around the same timestamps, likely canary started cold model loads on sidecars

derek_oncall: deploying rollback for the canary in eu now (last deploy at 2024-11-14T02:12Z looked suspicious)

ops-lead: post the rollback command so CS can reference it.

derek_oncall: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/api-eu --to-revision=3` (running)

incident-bot: Rollback job 67321 started. PagerDuty notified of mitigation action.

samir: monitoring post-rollback. initial numbers: p95 -> 600ms, p99 -> 1.1s within 2m :thumbsup:

morgan: confirmed. traffic is now on older model variant and kvcache rehydration in progress. Still watching for recurrence.

maya: adding temporary autoscale bump for eu: replicas 6 -> 9 for 10m to avoid capacity pressure while cache warms

morgan: customer impact summary: no increase in 5xx errors observed, but interactive latency (streaming chat) experienced degradation ~8m for EU users. CS notified with key timelines.

eng-manager: for the postmortem: capture the model load pattern and evaluate pre-warm strategy for canaries. assigning follow-up to @samir.

samir: will reproduce offline, run synthetic cold-start eval, and propose fix (pre-warm or staggered rollouts).

morgan: handing off to night shift — next oncall is @derek_night. Summary + links below:
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/inference/d/latency
- PagerDuty: https://pd.redwood/PD-2791

derek_night: acked. taking over monitoring. set 30m watch window and alert if p99 > 1.5s for 3m.

incident-bot: Incident PD-2791 marked resolved (mitigation: rollback + autoscale). automated note: "rollback mitigated latency spike" :white_check_mark:

morgan: thanks all. scheduling a short retro tomorrow 10:00am PT. I'll add notes to the incident board and link follow-ups.
